doc: Declared scope metadata for hook checks whose lesson only applies in a specific context (ISSUE_08 C11). Policy: absence from this file = universal scope = always run. Entries document intent and drive guard tests; they never disable a check at runtime (fail-safe: undecidable scope runs). Design: .devin/docs/HOOK-SCOPING.md.

scoped_arms.why: NUL/CON/AUX/PRN/COM1-9/LPT1-9 are Win32 devices; on POSIX they are ordinary legal filenames.
'name:stream' is an NTFS alternate data stream; ':' is a legal POSIX filename char.
Win32 strips trailing dots/spaces from basenames; POSIX keeps 'f.' as a distinct file.
_check_reserved_name early-returns on non-nt: device names, ADS ':' and dot-strip are Win32 write semantics.
/d/x -> D:\x translation is MSYS/Git-Bash-on-Windows only; on POSIX /d/x is a real absolute path.
